title: [Block Chain Security] Closer Connections Lead to Blurred Responsibility
description: [Special Feature 2/3] Closer Connections Lead to Blurred Responsibility | Block Chain Security — Not Just a Cardano Problem On Part 1, we posed the question of "Did we protect the mainnets but overlook the borders" with a case of the Wanchain bridge, which connects Cardano and BNB chain, which led to a security breach. In Part 2, we broaden our perspective to include the entire industry, examining security issues at different points: hardware wallets, exchanges, and interchain protocols. We show that incidents occurring in different places are actually rooted in the same structural cause. The concept that "separating private keys from the internet through hardware is safe" is a foundational premise for hardware wallets. However, this foundation was shaken starting from July 30, 2026, when a security breach occurred in Bitcoin hardware wallets.

description: Safe wallets but why do money vanish? — Report on the Shadows ① This is the first article in a series that examines five recurring points of damage observed in the periphery of the Cardano ecosystem. The issue lies not within the chain itself, but at the intersection of the chain and the people — specifically, the gap between wallet applications and how they store data on devices.
